name: SUNY Purchase — Conservatory of Dance, BFA in Dance
applicationSystem: SUNY Application OR Common App + Purchase supplement

fit.note: Ballet + modern/contemporary conservatory. Audition solo must be ballet/modern/contemporary — NOT jazz. Jazz/commercial are electives only.

rounds.label: Priority / rolling (audition-paced)

academicDeadline.note: Dance BFA Application Deadline: Feb 1, 2027, listed under the deadlines page's 'Fall 2027' cycle section. EA is NOT offered to Dance.

artsSupplementDeadline.note: Portfolio Submission (resume + photo + $65 fee) due Feb 8, 2027 per the Fall 2027 Dance BFA row on the deadlines page — unlocks audition sign-up.

decisionRelease.note: Notified ~3–4 weeks after audition; college-wide no later than ~April 1.

rounds.notes: Apply via SUNY Application OR Common App (+ Purchase Freshmen Supplemental). App fee $50.

portal.note: NOT Acceptd/SlideRoom for Dance (a 3rd-party BalletScout listing exists) — confirm.

fee.note: Non-refundable audition fee, paid via the Admissions Portal. Re-confirmed verbatim ("$65, non-refundable fee") on the live Fall-2027 audition-info page.

deadline.note: Still no explicit registration cutoff — page only says "Advanced registration is required." Note the Feb 8, 2027 Portfolio Submission deadline falls AFTER the first on-campus audition date (Feb 6, 2027); mechanism unclear — needs a call/email to dance@purchase.edu to clarify, do not assume.

prescreenRequired.note: No prescreen video for Dance. Submit resume + photo + fee, then register for the live audition.

value.text: One Artistic Letter of Recommendation, sent by the recommender to admissions@purchase.edu.
90-second solo at the audition: classical/contemporary ballet, modern, or contemporary (NOT jazz). Anything over 90s is stopped; no costumes.
Bring a printed copy of your submitted College Essay to the audition.

videoSpec.note: Added the College Essay copy requirement, newly surfaced on an Aug 2026 re-check of the audition page.

auditions.label: On-campus audition (Westchester)

date.note: Four Fall 2027 on-campus audition dates now published — applicant registers for ONE: Sat Feb 6, Fri Feb 12, Sat Feb 20, Fri Feb 26, 2027 (supersedes prior-cycle Feb 8/14/22/28, 2026 dates). Value here is the earliest date; see the audition's 'notes' field for the full list. No tour cities for Dance.

registrationOpens.note: Page states "Advanced registration is required" but gives no opening date.

registrationDeadline.note: No distinct per-date registration cutoff published beyond the Feb 8, 2027 Portfolio Submission deadline.

auditions.notes: ~35 min from Grand Central. Open class: ~1h ballet + ~1h modern + improv, then finalists do the 90s solo + interview. Fall 2027 on-campus dates: Sat 2/6, Fri 2/12, Sat 2/20, Fri 2/26, 2027 — pick one.

auditions.label: Video audition (verify eligibility)

date.note: Aug 2026 re-check: page still frames this ONLY for international applicants — exact quote: "International Applicants: If you are unable to attend in person, please contact dance@purchase.edu to discuss alternate arrangements." No mention of a domestic/distance path. A PR-based applicant's eligibility remains UNCONFIRMED — still requires directly emailing dance@purchase.edu.

auditions.notes: HIGH-PRIORITY open question — do not assume the on-campus requirement is waived. Aug 2026: audition page's alternate-arrangement language is still explicitly scoped to "International Applicants" only; still need to email dance@purchase.edu to ask whether a PR-based domestic applicant qualifies.

recommendations.value: At least one general letter + one Artistic Letter of Recommendation (dance teacher) emailed to admissions@purchase.edu.
recommendations.note: Re-confirmed: "One Artistic Letter of Recommendation – must be sent directly by the recommender to admissions@purchase.edu."

value.prompt: 'Think Wide Open' prompt — essay, video, or previously graded work (B+ or better).

interview.value: Brief interview for finalists at the audition
interview.note: Re-confirmed on the current audition page.

scholarships.name: Barrington Daley Scholarship

requiresSeparateApp.note: Via audition/admission review; no separate app.

scholarships.notes: Incoming freshman; professionalism, citizenship, dance talent.

fafsaRequired.note: Re-confirmed — page references FAFSA, TAP, DREAM Act, Excelsior; no CSS Profile mention either way.

priorityDeadline.note: 2027-28 FAFSA priority date still not published. Page only says "Apply as early as possible. It may take several weeks to determine your eligibility."

tuitionAnnual.note: PR residents pay OUT-OF-STATE. Page labeled "Tentative Costs for 2026–2027": tuition $9,010/sem + fees $973/sem = $19,966/yr (off-campus rate; tuition+fees only). This is the 2026-27 (current) academic year, NOT yet Elena's 2027-28 entry-year rate — still to be published.

totalCostOfAttendance.note: Out-of-state on-campus COA breakdown ("Tentative" 2026-27): tuition $16,980 + fees $1,883 + food/housing $17,850 + orientation $175–210 + books $1,240 + transportation $1,250 + personal $2,220 ≈ $41,600 (excludes the $2,514 Music course fee, not applicable to Dance). PR residents ineligible for NY TAP/Excelsior. 2027-28 (Elena's entry year) figures not yet published.

acceptanceRate.value: University ~74%; Dance BFA audition-gated (far more selective)

companyAffiliation.value: Purchase Dance Company; NYC seasons (e.g. New York Live Arts)

notable.value: Alumni with Ailey, ABT, Boston Ballet, Graham, Mark Morris, Parsons, Broadway. Director Nelly van Bommel.
